title: Urgent Bank Account Suspension
pattern_text: Security Alert: Your Chase Bank online access has been temporarily restricted due to unauthorized login attempts. Verify your identity immediately within 24 hours at http://chase-security-verify-auth.com or your account will be permanently locked.
risk_indicators: Sensational urgency ('within 24 hours')
Link domain 'chase-security-verify-auth.com' is not official chase.com
Generic greeting or no account identifier
recommendation: Do not click the link. Open your bank app directly or call the official phone number printed on your bank card.

title: Data Entry Specialist Cheque Deposit Scam
pattern_text: Congratulations! You have been selected for the Data Entry Remote position at Apex Global Solutions. We will send you a cashier's cheque of $3,500 to purchase home office equipment from our approved vendor. You will deposit the cheque, keep $500 as your sign-on bonus, and Zelle/Venmo the remaining $3,000 to our equipment supplier.
risk_indicators: Job offered without formal video/in-person interview
Request to deposit a check and send funds back via Zelle/Venmo/Wire
Equipment supplier requires peer-to-peer non-refundable payment
recommendation: Never deposit a check from an employer with instructions to wire or transfer any portion of the money back. The check will bounce after a few days.

title: USPS / FedEx Failed Delivery Fee
pattern_text: USPS Notification: Package #US954201888 cannot be delivered due to an incomplete street address. A redelivery fee of $1.50 is required. Please update your details now at http://usps-redeliver-parcel.top/update
risk_indicators: Sent via SMS from a random 10-digit number or international code
URL uses top-level domain '.top' or suspicious domain instead of usps.com
Requests small payment to steal credit card details
recommendation: Official postal services do not require credit card payments via SMS link for redelivery. Track packages directly on usps.com.

title: Guaranteed Telegram Crypto Trading Bot
pattern_text: Turn $200 into $5,000 in 24 hours guaranteed! Join our VIP Telegram Signal group. Our AI algorithmic trading bot guarantees zero loss. Send USDT (TRC-20) to wallet address T9xZ... to activate your high-yield automated portfolio now!
risk_indicators: Claims of 'guaranteed returns' or 'zero risk'
Payment requested exclusively via cryptocurrency transfer (USDT, BTC)
Communication restricted to Telegram or WhatsApp admins
recommendation: All investments carry risk. No genuine platform can guarantee 20x returns overnight. Once crypto is transferred, it cannot be recovered.

title: Geek Squad / Refund Auto-Renewal Invoice
pattern_text: Geek Squad Invoice #GS-88491: Thank you for your auto-renewal subscription of $499.99 charged to your Visa card. If you did not authorize this payment or wish to cancel and request a full refund, call our billing department immediately at +1 (888) 555-0199.
risk_indicators: No customer name or actual account billing history
Forces customer to call a phone number rather than managing subscription online
Call center agent will ask to install AnyDesk/TeamViewer to process 'refund'
recommendation: Do not call the number. Check your actual credit card statement online to confirm no charge was made.

title: Urgent Request from CEO / Supervisor
pattern_text: Hi, I am in a confidential board meeting right now and cannot take calls. I need you to purchase 5 Apple Gift Cards ($100 each) for client appreciation gifts immediately. Send me photos of the card codes on the back as soon as you scratch them. I will reimburse you today.
risk_indicators: Request sent from unfamiliar external email address or mobile number
Demands scratch-off codes from physical gift cards
Claims to be in a meeting or unavailable for phone verification
recommendation: Verify by calling your supervisor through official company communication channels (Teams, Slack, or direct company phone).

title: Military Officer Overseas Emergency
pattern_text: My dearest love, my deployed unit in Syria encountered unexpected customs fees for my medical discharge documents. I need $1,200 transferred to my diplomat agent via Western Union or Bitcoin today so I can fly home to be with you forever.
risk_indicators: Online acquaintance who avoids live video chats
Escalates romantic intimacy rapidly without meeting in person
Sudden financial crisis requiring immediate money transfer
recommendation: Never send money, wire transfers, or crypto to someone you have only met online.

title: Virtual Internship Training Fee & Stipend Deposit Scam
pattern_text: Congratulations Student! You have been selected for a 3-Month Remote AI & Web Development Virtual Internship at FutureTech Innovations! Offer Letter is attached. To reserve your candidate slot and issue your employee ID, pay a refundable training & stipend security deposit of $150 via Zelle / UPI / Wire within 6 hours. Registration closes today.
risk_indicators: Legitimate employers NEVER ask candidates or interns to pay training, registration, or security deposit fees.
Offered job/internship without any technical assessment or interview.
Uses artificial deadline ('pay within 6 hours') to panic students.
recommendation: Never pay money to get an internship or job. Authentic internships pay you for your work, not the other way around. Verify company registration on LinkedIn or official corporate site.

title: Mandatory LMS Course & Certificate Purchase Scam
pattern_text: Dear Applicant, Your application for Software Engineer Intern at Global Tech Systems has been provisionally accepted. However, to complete your onboarding, you must purchase the mandatory Industry Cyber Certificate ($89) from our partner learning portal http://globaltech-lms-certify.net before your start date.
risk_indicators: Requires applicant to purchase courses or certificates from an unverified third-party website.
The hiring company and LMS portal are run by the same scammers to collect payment details.
Offer letter is generic and missing specific manager contact information.
recommendation: Legitimate corporate internships provide internal onboarding training for free. Do not purchase third-party courses or certificates required by unverified recruiters.

title: Unsolicited Telegram/WhatsApp Task & Stipend Activation Scam
pattern_text: Dear Candidate, We noticed your profile on LinkedIn for a Student AI & Data Analyst Remote Intern position at Apex Digital! Earn $300/week by completing daily online rating tasks. No experience needed! Pay a 1-time candidate account activation fee of $50 in crypto/UPI to unlock your stipend dashboard and work portal.
risk_indicators: Recruiter approaches via WhatsApp or Telegram rather than official corporate email domain.
Requires paying an 'account activation fee' or 'stipend security deposit' to unlock work tasks.
Promises unrealistically high weekly stipends for simple rating tasks.
recommendation: Never pay activation fees to receive work assignments or stipends. Real companies onboard interns through official HR software and NEVER request fees for account setup.

title: Fake Academic Research Internship & Paper Publication Fee Scam
pattern_text: Respected Student, Your research proposal for the International Summer AI & Machine Learning Research Internship has been accepted! To confirm your research slot and publish your co-authored paper in our indexed IEEE/Scopus journal partner, submit a paper processing fee of $200 within 48 hours to http://academic-research-portal-fee.org/pay.
risk_indicators: Legitimate research internships provide stipends or academic credits; they do not sell paper publication slots.
Requires immediate payment via external suspicious link within tight 48-hour deadline.
Unverified journal domain mimicking prestigious academic indexing services.
recommendation: Check with your university professor or department head before paying any journal or paper publishing fees associated with an internship.

title: Standard Amazon Order Confirmation
pattern_text: Amazon.com: Your order #114-9842104-5829104 has shipped. You can track your package or view order details anytime in your Amazon account dashboard. Thank you for shopping with us.
recommendation: Safe message. Links direct to official amazon.com domain.

title: Two-Factor Security Code (2FA)
pattern_text: Your Google verification code is 482910. Do not share this code with anyone. Google will never call or message you to ask for this code.
recommendation: Legitimate verification code. Keep it private and never share with callers.
